bŏnāsus , i, m., = βόνασος,
I.a species of bull in Pœonia, with the hair of a horse, and with horns unfit for fighting, hence saving itself by flight, Plin. 8, 15, 16, § 40; Sol. 40; cf. Aristot. H. A. 9, 45.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
